text.en:
Passively grants +20 Airborne Effectiveness.

Marks enemies for 5 seconds after hovering your reticle near them for 1 second.
Mark persists through walls.

If Enemy is below 30% HP: 
Grants 1% increased damage for every percent below 30%
(Eg: 10% HP left -> 20% Damage Increase)

Damage Increase applies to all damage dealt.
text.ko:
상시 공중 효율을 20만큼 증가시킵니다.

1초 동안 적 근처에 조준을 하면 5초간 표식을 남깁니다.
표식은 벽을 통해서 볼 수 있습니다.

적의 체력이 30% 이하 일 때:
30%로 부터 남은 체력의 %당 1%의 추가 피해를 받습니다.
(예: 체력 10% -> 20% 피해 증가)

피해 증가는 능력과 무기에 모두 적용됩니다.
text.zh-chs:
被动提供 +20 空中效率。

准星悬停在敌人附近 1 秒后，标记敌人 5 秒。
标记穿墙可见。

如果敌人血量低于 30%：
提供低于 30% 对应百分数的伤害提高。
（例如：剩 10% 的血量 -> 伤害增加 20%）

伤害提高适用于所有造成的伤害。

Dealing Ability Damage to a <link Major, Boss, or Player [#CombatantClassifications] /> target grants 4 Stacks of Subclass-Matching Weapon Surge and highlights the target for 10 seconds each. Weapon Surge duration is not refreshable.

Killing highlighted targets spawns a Subclass-Matching Elemental Pickup.

Elementa Pickups include <solar/>Firesprites, <arc/>Ionic Traces, <stasis/>Stasis Shards, <strand/>Strand Tangles, and <void/>Void Breaches.

text.en:
Dealing Ability Damage to a <link Major, Boss, or Player [#CombatantClassifications] /> target grants 4 Stacks of Weapon Surge matching the element of the used ability and highlights the target for 10 seconds.

Weapon Surge duration is not refreshable.

Killing highlighted targets spawns a Subclass-Matching Elemental Pickup.

Elemental Pickups include <solar/>Firesprites, <arc/>Ionic Traces, <stasis/>Stasis Shards, <strand/>Strand Tangles, and <void/>Void Breaches.

Dealing Ability Damage to an <link Elite, Miniboss, Boss, or Player [#CombatantClassifications] /> target highlights the target and grants 4 Stacks of Weapon Surge matching the element of the used ability for 10 seconds.

Weapon Surge duration is not refreshable.

Killing highlighted targets spawns a Subclass-Matching Elemental Pickup.

Elemental Pickups include <solar/>Firesprites, <arc/>Ionic Traces, <stasis/>Stasis Shards, <strand/>Strand Tangles, and <void/>Void Breaches.

Dealing Ability Damage to an <link Elite, Miniboss, Boss, or Player [#CombatantClassifications] /> target highlights them and grants 4 Stacks of Weapon Surge matching the element of the used ability for <pve 11 /> <pvp [6] /> seconds.

Weapon Surge duration is not refreshable.

Killing highlighted targets spawns a Subclass-Matching Elemental Pickup.

Elemental Pickups include <solar/>Firesprites, <arc/>Ionic Traces, <stasis/>Stasis Shards, <strand/>Strand Tangles, and <void/>Void Breaches.

Dealing Ability Damage to an <link Elite, Miniboss, Boss, or Player [#CombatantClassifications] /> target highlights them and grants 4 Stacks of Weapon Surge matching the element of the used ability for <pve 11 /> <pvp [6] /> seconds.

Weapon Surge duration is not refreshable. Currently does not work with <solar/>Solar abilties.

Killing highlighted targets spawns a Subclass-Matching Elemental Pickup.

#elementalPickup

Dealing Ability Damage to an <link Elite, Miniboss, Boss, or Player [#CombatantClassifications] /> target highlights them and grants 4 Stacks of Weapon Surge matching the element of the used ability for <pve 11 /> <pvp [6] /> seconds.

Weapon Surge duration is not refreshable. Currently does not work with <solar/>Solar abilities.

Killing highlighted targets spawns a Subclass-Matching Elemental Pickup.

#elementalPickup

Dealing Ability Damage to an <link Elite, Miniboss, Boss, or Player [#CombatantClassifications] /> target highlights them and grants 4 Stacks of Weapon Surge matching the element of the used ability for <pve 15 /> <pvp [6] /> seconds.

Weapon Surge duration is not refreshable. Currently does not work with <solar/>Solar abilities.

Killing highlighted targets spawns a Subclass-Matching Elemental Pickup.

#elementalPickup

Dealing Ability damage to an <link Elite, Miniboss, Boss, or Player [#CombatantClassifications] /> target highlights them for 10 seconds and grants 4 Stacks of Weapon Surge matching the element of the used ability for <pve 16 /> <pvp [11] /> seconds.

Highlight duration is not refreshable. Dealing Ability damage to highlighted targets does not grant you the Weapon Surge benefit.

Killing highlighted targets spawns a Subclass-Matching Elemental Pickup.

#elementalPickup

Dealing Ability damage to an <link Elite, Miniboss, Boss, or Player [#CombatantClassifications] /> target highlights them for 10 seconds and grants 4 Stacks of Weapon Surge matching the element of the used ability for <pve 16 /> <pvp [11] /> seconds.

Highlight duration is not refreshable. Dealing Ability damage to already highlighted targets does not grant you the Weapon Surge benefit.

Killing highlighted targets spawns a Subclass-Matching Elemental Pickup.

#elementalPickup

Dealing ability damage to unhighlighted <link Elite, Miniboss, Boss, or Player [#CombatantClassifications] /> targets highlights them for 10 seconds and grants 4 Stacks of Weapon Surge matching the element of the used ability for <pve 16 /> <pvp [11] /> seconds.

Highlight duration is not refreshable.

Killing highlighted targets with weapons matching the element of the highlighting ability spawns an Elemental Pickup corresponding to the element in question.

#elementalPickup

Dealing ability damage to unhighlighted <link Elite, Miniboss, Boss, or Player [#CombatantClassifications] /> targets highlights them for 10 seconds and grants 4 Stacks of Weapon Surge matching the element of the used ability for <pve 16 /> <pvp [11] /> seconds.

Highlight duration is not refreshable.

Killing highlighted targets with weapons matching the element of the highlighting ability spawns an Elemental Pickup corresponding to the element in question.

#ElementalPickup
